description:
The prince in my dreams is confessing to me now, isn't he?! Wait, is this a dream? Dream right? Silver, a job-preparatory student who has been hit by reality, has a small secret. That there is another world in her dreams! In her dream, "Silver" also uses superpowers, is a tremendous beauty, and meets the ideal prince. While comforting the tired mind of reality in a dream that she does not want to wake up, a tragedy that is about to come also comes. “... This man, you can never let him die!" Now it doesn't matter if this is a dream or not. 'Silver' decides to join the war in the dream world for him who needs his powers. For the love in dreams that real people can't understand!"
